environment.description: Django REST API deployed on EC2 behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer, Layer 4 only). PyJWT version 2.6.0 installed. JWT_HMAC_SECRET is a 256-bit hex string loaded from environment. JWT_PUBLIC_KEY is the RSA public key in PEM format. No request-level filtering or token validation occurs outside the application code. The application's settings.JWT_MAX_AGE is set to 300 seconds. Redis revocation list is empty by default.
